📦 Products — All Inventory
Enter rate per piece per day, choose Calculation Type (Daily, or One Month + Extra Days) for that product, then enter quantity. Subtotal: Daily = Qty × Rate × Days; 1 Month + Extra Days = Qty × Month Rate + Qty × Rate × (Days − 30, minimum 0). Select items from both Main and Sub inventory in one bill.
#ProductAvailableRate (Rs/pc/day) *Calc TypeRate (Rs/pc/month)QtySubtotal

📅 Monthly Bills — 30-Day Rent Collection
1 month = 30 rental days from the OUT date. Every completed 30-day month of an active bill / site is created here automatically — view or share its bill, and collect the rent while the material is still with the customer. Collected rent is deducted from the final return bill automatically (the customer is never charged twice).

✏️ Edit / Update Stock
Product name and Total Stock can be edited (tap 💾 Save). Out now = pieces currently out with customers / sites; it is calculated automatically from your bills (dispatch, return, site) and stays correct when a bill is added, edited (+ / −) or deleted. Available = Total − Out now, so it can never be more than Total. If anything ever looks wrong, tap 🔄 Recalculate.

🗄️ Full Data Backup
This app runs fully offline — all business data (rentals, customers, employees, attendance, payroll, expenses, income, maintenance, inventory) is stored only on this device's browser storage. Clearing browser/site data will remove it permanently. Export a backup regularly and keep the file safe.
⚠ Restoring a backup will replace all current data on this device. Export a fresh backup first if unsure.
